test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 27 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A and B can do a work in 13 days and 26 days, respectively. If they work for a day alternately, starting with A, then in how many days will the work be completed?
solution:
**Given:**

A can complete the work in 13 days

B can complete the work in 26 days

**Formula used:**

Work done by A in 1 day = 1 / 13

Work done by B in 1 day = 1 / 26

**Calculation:**

In 2 days (one day by A and one day by B):

Work done by A in 1 day = 1 / 13

Work done by B in 1 day = 1 / 26

Combined work done in 2 days = (1 / 13) + (1 / 26)

⇒ (2 / 26) + (1 / 26)

⇒ 3 / 26

In 2 days, 3/26 of the work is completed.

To complete the entire work (1), calculate the number of 2-day cycles required:

Total cycles required = 26 / 3

⇒ 8.67 cycles

So, the work will be completed in 17 days, with A working on the first and every alternate day, and B working on the remaining days.

**∴ The work will be completed in 17 days.**
